data.name: 大侠狂想曲
data.detailed_description:
Story Introduction

   《大侠狂想曲》 is a martial arts game that blends farming, adventure, and romance.

You were once an ordinary village boy. An unexpected encounter with a demon puts your life on the line. Fortunately, a disciple of the Taixuan Sword Sect rescues you. From then on, the gears of fate begin to turn.

You will journey into the martial arts world, meet various heroes, cultivate your inner cultivation, open up your meridians, and ascend to a powerful master, rising from obscurity to a formidable figure.

During your adventure, you will encounter girls with diverse destinies—some as cold as ice, some as cunning as a fox, and some harboring secrets. Your presence will alter the trajectory of their fates.

Behind the seemingly vibrant and bustling martial arts world lies a conspiracy that could subvert the world...

Introduction to the female lead

She was a strikingly beautiful widow from the village of Rivendell. Her husband died in a monster attack when she was young, and she has lived alone ever since.

She appears gentle on the outside, yet possesses a strong and wise heart. She knows when to bow her head and when to yield, simply to survive in this cruel world.

But fate did not spare her—rumors, coercion, power, and desire repeatedly pushed her to despair.

She wasn't old, but her youth had long since faded.

Her parents died young, her home seized by village tyrants, and she was left huddled in a dilapidated house in the wilderness, relying on a dim lamp and the chill wind for comfort.

She was sensible and gentle, yet she understood the cruelty of life better than anyone.

She had thought her days could continue in this peaceful way...

But no one knew that, beneath the stillness of the night, a pair of demonic claws were silently reaching out to her.

She is a key figure in the Tianlong Gang, sharing power with her brother, Hong Lie.

She is strong-willed, protective, honest, and loyal. In this ruthless world, she strives to free the Tianlong Gang from its reputation as a "gangster" and return it to the right path.

However, the closer she gets to her ideal, the deeper the shadows grow—

With internal and external troubles looming, what course should she take?

A female warrior with a gentle appearance and a strong character, she navigates the martial arts world with exceptional swordsmanship and unwavering conviction.

She cleaves to no faction, nor does she covet fame or fortune. She fights alongside the hero in numerous adventures, supporting each other, and their relationship gradually blossoms.

However, the complexities of the martial arts world, and with the constant temptations and trials that follow, how will she choose?
